LanguageData.Raven_Building_EmberExtractor.label: [Raven] Ember Extractor
LanguageData.Raven_Building_EmberExtractor.descriptio: A precise biochemical alchemy device capable of safely extracting the Raven Golden Crow bloodline essence from a Raven's body without harming the subject's life.\n\nThe extraction process will leave the subject in a prolonged state of "Ember Depletion," during which no further extractions can be performed.
